prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, eye-level shot of a white porcelain bathroom sink with two classic, chrome-plated cross-handle faucets, both running water into the basin. The background features a neutral, beige-tiled wall, softly out of focus, creating a clean and minimalistic setting. The water streams are captured mid-flow, with gentle ripples and bubbles forming in the partially filled sink, adding a sense of motion and freshness. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the reflective surfaces of the faucets and the smooth texture of the sink. The overall color palette is composed of whites, silvers, and warm beige tones, evoking a sense of cleanliness and simplicity. Bold, white sans-serif text reading “Double tap on your screen” is prominently overlaid at the top of the image, standing out clearly against the background. The composition is symmetrical, with both faucets centered and balanced, creating a visually pleasing and inviting scene.
